method: One MATERIALIZED start-clock CTE, one actual public RPC evaluation, then server end-clock; client timer surrounds execute/fetch. Server elapsed includes waits/execution, excludes parse/plan and network. Not HTTP latency.
source_data: Synthetic catalog/identities; 100% invented rows, no customer dumps
shape: 70% custom,20% ready-made,10% mixed; two items on mixed orders; 10% customer103/SC101/factory104 scope across all order types; two-year creation span; 1/3 completed; 1/37 canceled. This deterministic synthetic mix is not an assertion about the real production distribution.
verification: Untimed replay/scope/money/quantity assertions follow calls inside the same transaction. Command/quote sample transactions roll back. Hot-record tests commit own rows.
